SignalR.// ConnectionString: Endpoint=https://<name>.service.signalr.net;AccessKey=<key>;Version=1.0; — set this in the deployed environment (an Application Setting, so Azure__SignalR__ConnectionString). Left EMPTY here on purpose: with no value the host falls back to self-hosted SignalR, so chat runs end to end on a dev machine without provisioning an Azure SignalR resource. Default mode is what a hub-hosting app needs; serverless mode is for Functions.

_comment: This host sends its OWN pushes for chat, which is why it is the one API host that
references Firebase at all. Same shape and same credentials as Pawfront.Functions.
Supply the service-account JSON (Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts)
ONE of two ways: CredentialsFilePath for a local gitignored file, or
CredentialsSecretName for a Key Vault secret in deployed environments. The JSON holds a
private key, so it must never be pasted into this file.
